content.title: WHAT YOUR BODY IS TRYING TO {{TELL}} YOU
facts: **Iron** – Pale skin, constant fatigue, shortness of breath, and brittle nails.
**Vitamin D** – Bone aches, frequent colds, muscle weakness, and low mood in darker months.
**Magnesium** – Muscle cramps, twitching eyelids, poor sleep, and irritability.
**Vitamin B12** – Tingling in hands/feet, weakness, memory problems, and low mood.
**Zinc** – Slow wound healing, frequent infections, hair thinning, and reduced sense of taste.
**Potassium** – Muscle weakness, irregular heartbeat, fatigue, and leg cramps.
